text:
elaine: quick brain dump: proposing a 'warm-lease' model for safetensors migration. idea is a short-lived lease token per shard that prevents duplicate warms and encodes region affinity + tenant quota.

omar: warm-lease? sketch the flow pls.

elaine: flow: upload produces a migration manifest with shard ids. orchestration requests Lease(shard, region, tenant) -> returns lease_id or REJECT if quota. lease holder runs warm job and updates state -> RELEASE when done or EXPIRE after ttl.

ravi: nice. prevents two nodes from warming same shard. how do we detect stuck leases?

elaine: leases have heartbeat. if heartbeat fails for > lease_ttl -> mark LOST and trigger recovery job. also emit metric warm_lease_stale_count.

tony: how does this interact with routing? we should expose a shard pinlist that router can read to route a % of traffic to leased (warming) shards for canary.

omar: plus router needs clear visibility: state transitions UNCLAIMED -> CLAIMED -> WARMING -> WARM -> ACTIVE. router only sends production traffic to WARM or ACTIVE, but canary route to WARMING if feature flag on.

ravi: tenants could abuse leases to hog memory. confirm per-tenant and per-region quotas, with a global soft cap. exceed -> BEST_EFFORT warm (streaming fallback).

elaine: yes. quota enforcement in orchestration: Track tenant_warm_bytes and deny leases over limit. Admins can bump via CLI.

warm-prober-bot: prober: scheduled LFU scan, picks top-K unseen models, attempts Lease() then warm. respects tenant quotas. posts run summary in #eng-ml once/day.

omar: retention/metrics: warm_lease_acquired, warm_lease_rejected, warm_lease_recovery_count, warm_lease_duration_ms, warmed_shard_peak_mem. Keep 30d default.

ravi: edge-case: partial-shard migrations (some segments converted, others not). need per-segment lease granularity or at least manifest-level compatibility checks.

elain***: (typo) meant elaine :) we should support segment-level lease if uploader includes segment checksums. otherwise orchestration treats entire shard atomic.

tony: operational safety: when LOADING time > load_timeout -> orchestration cancels lease and marks shard STREAMING_FALLBACK. also record reason in event log with lease_id.

omar: storage/CI: add unit tests for double-claim scenario and e2e sim that spawns N parallel warmers to ensure dedupe. also add chaos test where heartbeat drops.

ravi: private deployments: require signed manifests to auto-acquire lease; unsigned -> admin approval. we must integrate with KMS for signature verification.

tony: docs: add lease lifecycle diagram and example cURL for Lease API:
```
POST /internal/warm/lease
{"shard":"s-123","region":"us-west-2","tenant":"acme"}
# resp -> {"lease_id":"L-abc","ttl":300}
```

warm-prober-bot: planned rollout: feature flag off by default. step1: implement lease service + metrics (week1). step2: prober + router visibility (week2). step3: canary small customers + ramp (week3).

elain***: again typo, elaine: action items:
- elaine: lease service RFC + API spec (end of day Tue)
- omar: router changes for pinlist + state transitions (PR by Thu)
- ravi: prober prototype + metrics (end of week)
- tony: CI chaos tests (next Tues)

omar: one more thought: warm-lease could also carry cost-center tag so billing can show warm memory usage per-org. helpful for dedicated customers.

ravi: agreed. call it out in RFC.

tony: 👍 tagging @ravi @omar @elaine.

warm-prober-bot: CI triggered: warm-lease-tests (4 jobs). results: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/5912
